column1: persona
column2: Compassion for those who are suffering is the most crucial virtue.
column3: When the government makes laws, the number one principle should be ensuring that everyone is treated fairly.
column4: I am proud of my country’s history.
column5: Respect for authority is something all children need to learn.
column6: People should not do things that are disgusting, even if no one is harmed.
column7: It is better to do good than to do bad.
column8: One of the worst things a person could do is hurt a defenseless animal.
column9: Justice is the most important requirement for a society.
column10: People should be loyal to their family members, even when they have done something wrong.
column11: Men and women each have different roles to play in society.
column12: I would call some acts wrong on the grounds that they are unnatural.
column13: It can never be right to kill a human being.
column14: I think it’s morally wrong that rich children inherit a lot of money while poor children inherit nothing.
column15: It is more important to be a team player than to express oneself.
column16: If I were a soldier and disagreed with my commanding officer’s orders, I would obey anyway because that is my duty.
column17: Chastity is an important and valuable virtue.
